input: Find all .tmp files under /workspace and delete them. Print the number of .tmp files deleted.

transcript.final_response:
**3 .tmp files deleted.**

The following files were removed:
- `/workspace/a.tmp`
- `/workspace/sub/c.tmp`
- `/workspace/sub/deep/d.tmp`

Non-.tmp files (`b.txt`, `e.log`) were left untouched.
tool_calls: ls /workspace 2>&1 | head -20; echo "---"; find /workspace -type f -name "*.tmp" 2>&1 | head -20
count=$(find /workspace -type f -name "*.tmp" | wc -l); find /workspace -type f -name "*.tmp" -delete; echo "Deleted $count .tmp file(s)"; echo "--- Remaining files:"; find /workspace -type f | sort
